notes: Jilan Flight Info v1.0: check flight departures and arrivals at Pakistan airports (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Multan, Faisalabad, Peshawar, Quetta, Sialkot) with flight information from the official Pakistan Airports Authority website (paa.gov.pk) inside the app, with a how-to guide and before-you-fly tips. The old Civil Aviation Authority website is also linked in the app as Civil Aviation Authority (PCAA). The app collects and saves nothing.
